method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: U.S. tariff-hike threats pile pressure on partners to sign trade deals
Equities.summary: The U.S. planned a fresh tariff salvo on 14 trading partners, while offering some countries lower rates if they secure trade deals with Washington.
Equities.reason: Broad, market-level trade policy shock increases geopolitical and growth risk for global equities. Tariff threats raise uncertainty for multinational earnings and supply chains — negative for overall risk sentiment and the dominant market regime.

Equities.title: How Trump’s latest tariff moves hand India an edge over rival Asian exporters
Equities.summary: Proposed tariffs of 18% on Bangladesh, Cambodia, Thailand, and 20% on China and Vietnam, subject to their respective trade deals, offer India a competitive advantage.
Equities.reason: Tariff-induced reallocation of trade flows creates winners/losers regionally. For broad equities this reinforces fragmentation and policy risk (net negative), while providing a positive idiosyncratic tilt to India — lower relevance than the primary global-risk signal.

Equities.title: Tech stocks set for worst month in four years as volatility surges
Equities.summary: All-powerful AI trade has been eclipsed by wild swings in a market struggling to price future earnings
Equities.reason: Signals a broader market regime shift: AI leadership is under pressure and elevated volatility makes pricing of future earnings harder — meaningful negative for tech-heavy equity indices and market risk appetite.

Equities.title: S&P warns Nvidia credit rating could be cut over 'rising' management and governance risk
Equities.summary: S&P Global Ratings said Nvidia's credit rating could be cut by one notch as it flagged "rising" management and governance risk at the chipmaker.
Equities.reason: Nvidia is central to the AI-led equity narrative; governance/credit concerns increase idiosyncratic risk that can spill into the AI/semiconductor complex — negative for market leadership but narrower than macro shocks.

Equities.title: Nvidia chip buyers told to rule out Chinese renters to purchase GPUs, sources say
Equities.summary: A new BIS rule was intended to close "loopholes," U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer told CNBC's "Squawk Box" on Wednesday.
Equities.reason: Tighter export controls and restrictions on distribution channels materially raise regulatory risk for the AI supply chain and earnings of chipmakers and AI vendors — a significant negative for tech equities and the AI trade.

Equities.title: Chinese shares soar after Beijing signals more support
Equities.summary: CSI 300 index jumps more than 4% in afternoon trading
Equities.reason: Explicit government market-support signals are a clear liquidity/regime-positive for Chinese equities and regional risk appetite, partially offsetting global trade/tariff-driven risk — meaningful positive for EM/China exposure.

Equities.title: China Tech’s Earnings Offer Little Relief in Worst-Ever Year
Equities.reason: Weak earnings in China tech are a fundamental headwind for the sector despite policy support. Treated as a lower-relevance counter-signal to Beijing's market-support narrative.

Equities.title: Wall St futures surge as investors return from holiday
Equities.reason: Short-term market action indicating a risk-on bounce; useful as a near-term market-flow datapoint but limited standalone macro relevance.

Equities.title: China’s factories are growing profits again, but the AI boom is picking the winners
Equities.summary: China's economy has been running at two speeds, with AI-related manufacturing and exports powering growth while consumption, real estate investment lag.
Equities.reason: Confirms a two-speed China: policy and AI-related industrial strength support select sectors/exports — constructive for cyclicals and exporters tied to AI supply chains; reinforces differentiated equity exposures.

Equities.title: J.P. Morgan sees Indian stocks rise further in 2027 after 'great comeback' of 2026
Equities.reason: Institutional bullishness on India supports the narrative that tariffs and supply-chain reallocation are benefiting Indian markets — positive for regional equity allocations but narrower in global impact.

Rates.title: Is the Fed ready for its next fight?
Rates.summary: US central bank officials face a three-dimensional tussle over inflation, AI and guidance
Rates.reason: FT piece highlights Fed officials wrestling with inflation risks and policy guidance amid new shocks (AI); increases likelihood of higher-for-longer rates, negative for bond prices. High relevance due to Fed centrality to global rates.

Rates.title: Fed’s preferred inflation gauge lands with a December rate increase already priced in
Rates.reason: Article states the Fed's preferred inflation measure and market reaction imply a December rate hike is priced; direct market repricing toward tighter policy is strongly negative for bond prices (yields up).

Rates.title: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, October 27-28, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, October 27-28, 2026
Rates.reason: FOMC minutes are a primary window into Fed participants' views on the policy path; current Fed focus on inflation/growth implies continued vigilance and supports higher-for-longer rate expectations, negative for bonds.

Rates.title: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on October 19 and October 28, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Board's discount rate meetings on October 19 and October 28, 2026
Rates.reason: Discount rate meeting minutes provide additional Fed policy detail; interpreted as modestly hawkish in the current macro backdrop, adding incremental pressure on yields.

Rates.title: (BOJ Review) Developments in JGB Market-Making Business by Securities Companies
Rates.reason: BOJ review on JGB market-making speaks to liquidity/backstop improvements; better market-making and liquidity support is mildly positive for JGB prices (yields lower) and reduces tail-risk in the JGB market.

Rates.title: Breaking: Japan’s Tokyo CPI inflation climbs 2.8% in November
Rates.summary: The headline Tokyo Consumer Price Index (CPI) for November rose 2.8% YoY as compared to 2.7% in the previous month (revised from 2.8%), the Statistics Bureau of Japan showed on Friday.
Rates.reason: Hotter Tokyo CPI increases pressure on the BOJ to normalize policy sooner, raising JGB yield expectations. Significant regional inflation datapoint with strong transmission into rates.

Rates.title: IMF Urges RBA to Be Ready to Tighten Further If Prices Worsen
Rates.reason: IMF urging the RBA to be prepared to tighten reinforces market expectations of further policy tightening in Australia if inflation persists, negative for Australian sovereign bonds (yields higher).

FX.title: British Pound remains on the back foot vs USD as BoE rate hike bets limit downside
FX.summary: The GBP/USD pair trades with a negative bias for the second straight day, hovering around the 1.3100 mark during the Asian session on Friday amid a modest US Dollar (USD) uptick.
FX.reason: GBP trading softer vs USD but BoE rate-hike expectations cap downside. FX-native, short-term GBP vs USD bias; modestly USD-positive (hence negative direction for non-USD currencies).

FX.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Grinds higher above 1.3100, but stays bearish below 100-day SMA
FX.summary: The GBP/USD pair trades in positive territory near 1.3125 during the early European trading hours on Friday. Hawkish signals from Bank of England (BoE) policymakers provide some support to the British Pound (GBP) against the US Dollar (USD).
FX.reason: Technical/price-forecast piece (lower relevance). Near-term grind up but still structurally capped — modest negative tilt for GBP vs USD when viewed against the broader context of BoE/US rate expectations.

FX.title: Euro weakens to near 1.0950 on Fed hike outlook, de Cos poised to lead ECB
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair loses ground to near 1.0960 during the early Asian trading hours on Friday. The Euro (EUR) remains on the defensive against the US Dollar (USD) after falling to its lowest since April 2025 earlier in the week. The US Thanksgiving holiday keeps
FX.reason: EUR/USD weakness tied to firmer Fed/hike outlook and recent lows — clear USD support and EUR pressure; direct USD-centric FX transmission, moderate-high relevance.

FX.title: Spain’s Pablo Hernández de Cos set to lead European Central Bank
FX.summary: De Cos will lead the ECB into a period of political uncertainty and choppy growth, after winning the backing needed to succeed Christine Lagarde next year.
FX.reason: Major ECB leadership change is FX-relevant. The appointment creates policy/uncertainty implications for the euro; treated as modestly EUR-negative in near term given political/uncertainty framing.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Inflation strengthens case for December hike – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank strategist Volkmar Baur notes that Tokyo inflation remains above the Bank of Japan’s (BoJ) 2% target, with core prices at 2.5% year-on-year. He argues that inflation appears to be settling slightly above target and that producer price pressures are
FX.reason: Higher inflation supporting a nearer-term BoJ move is a clear yen-positive macro driver (JPY strength vs USD). FX-native policy/inflation signal — medium relevance.

FX.title: Tokyo inflation is forecast to jump to 3% with the Yen under 160.00
FX.summary: Tokyo's November inflation figures are forecast to jump to 3% from 2.6%, and they arrive after a call for faster rate rises failed to move the Yen for long.
FX.reason: Inflation forecast (not yet realized) increases the case for BoJ tightening and yen appreciation — technical/pre-announce signal so lower relevance than confirmed data or formal central-bank moves.

FX.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Bulls await 200-hour SMA break above 0.6670 amid softer USD
FX.summary: The AUD/USD pair attracts some buyers for the second straight day on Friday and touches a fresh weekly high, around the 0.6670 area during the Asian session amid modest US Dollar (USD) weakness.
FX.reason: Technical/price-forecast note: modest AUD bids amid a softer USD. Lower relevance because it's a technical intraday setup, but confirms USD softness theme.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar advances vs USD, retakes 0.5500 after NZ election results
FX.summary: The NZD/USD pair catches aggressive bids during the Asian session on Friday, hitting a fresh weekly top in the last hour and looking to extend the momentum further beyond the 0.5500 psychological mark.
FX.reason: Political/election outcome driving NZD strength vs USD — clear FX-native flow and meaningful for antipodean crosses; treated as moderately high relevance.

FX.title: Indian Rupee corrects further as renewed Hormuz risk lifts oil prices
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) extends correction further against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday. The USD/INR pair recovers further to near 92.75 as a sharp recovery in oil prices weighs on the Indian currency.
FX.reason: Oil-driven INR weakness lifts USD/INR (USD strength vs INR). Commodity/geo-risk transmission to EMFX — clear FX impact but regional (EM) scope.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index weakens below 104.00 as AI concerns simmer
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), an index of the value of the US Dollar (USD) measured against a basket of six world currencies, currently trades near 103.70 in the early European trading hours on Friday.
FX.reason: Direct DXY move: a softer dollar across its basket is the dominant FX transmission for many pairs. High FX-native relevance — signals broad currency strength vs USD in the near term.

FX.title: Dollar Set for Longest Winning Run Since 2024 on AI Risk
FX.reason: Major macro narrative asserting sustained USD strength on AI-related risk flows — high-impact USD-centric story that conflicts with some near-term DXY softness; treated as high-relevance USD-positive signal.

FX.title: China stocks, yuan rally after Beijing vows stronger market support
FX.reason: Beijing support bias lifts equities and the onshore/offshore yuan — EMFX-positive and USD-negative transmission for China-related FX flows; moderate relevance for broader FX backdrop.

Commodities.title: Gold extends gains to $3,650 as weak USD offsets Fed hike bets and geopolitical headwinds
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) builds on its steady intraday ascent, climbing beyond $3,650 during Friday’s Asian session and recovering further from the September 2025 lows it touched earlier this week.
Commodities.reason: Gold pushing above $3,600 on a softer USD and safe-haven/geopolitical demand is a clear positive price impulse for the precious-metals complex; relevance high due to size of move and USD transmission.

Commodities.title: Gold declines to near $3,550 amid hawkish Fed expectations
Commodities.summary: Gold price edges lower to around $3,565 during the early Asian session on Friday. The precious metal faces some selling pressure amid inflation concerns and expectations of a US Federal Reserve (Fed) interest rate hike next month.
Commodities.reason: Hawkish Fed expectations and inflation concerns create near-term selling pressure for gold via higher real yields; included as the countervailing USD/rates driver with moderate relevance.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD surges to near $43.75 as US Dollar remains in corrective phase
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) extends its two-day recovery on Friday, surging almost 5% to near $43.75 in the Asian trade. The white metal outperforms after a long underperformance as the US Dollar’s (USD) rally has come to a halt.
Commodities.reason: Sharp short-term rally in silver tied to a softer USD and catch-up demand; relevant for precious-metals flows and industrial/precious mix.

Commodities.title: WTI advances further beyond $85.00, over one-week top amid renewed supply disruption fears
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – attracts buyers for the fourth consecutive day on Friday, prolonging this week's goodish recovery from the $78.85 region, or its lowest level since August 10.
Commodities.reason: Sustained multi-day oil gains and a break above $85 driven by supply-disruption fears is a strong bullish signal for crude; high relevance given price momentum and macro impact on energy markets.

Commodities.title: Saudi Energy Ministry says strike on Jazan refinery halts some operations
Commodities.summary: The Saudi Energy Ministry said an attack on Saudi Arabia’s oil refinery in the southern province of Jazan temporarily halted some of the facility’s operations and killed one worker, Bloomberg reported on Thursday.
Commodities.reason: Reported refinery outage in Saudi Arabia directly reduces available product supply and supports oil-price risk premia; meaningful near-term bullish input for crude and refined products.

Commodities.title: Oil flows through Middle East chokepoints increased in the third quarter
Commodities.summary: Collective oil shipments through key chokepoints around the Middle East increased by 19% in the third quarter of 2026 (3Q26), according to our recently published Global Energy Security Data.
Commodities.reason: Higher transit volumes through chokepoints imply stronger physical flows/exports from the region in 3Q26, a modest bearish signal for oil supply tightness (quarterly, not an immediate shock).

Commodities.title: U.S. natural gas inventories end injection season above normal levels
Commodities.summary: Working natural gas in storage in the Lower 48 states ended the natural gas injection season at 3,810 billion cubic feet (Bcf), exceeding the five-year average by almost 2%, according to estimates based on data from our Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report releas
Commodities.reason: End-of-season storage above the five-year average is a bearish fundamental for U.S. natural-gas prices, reducing upside from weather-driven demand in the near term.

Commodities.title: Copper Rebounds From 11-Month Low on Return of Risk Appetite
Commodities.reason: Copper recovering from a multi-month low on improved risk sentiment points to renewed demand/positioning flows for industrial metals; relevant for base-metals price direction.

Commodities.title: Congo Closes on Top Copper Supplier Chile as Exports Soar Again
Commodities.reason: Surging Congolese copper exports imply rising global supply contribution from Africa, a medium-term headwind for copper prices despite near-term rebounds.

Commodities.title: Congo Gold Trader Plans Two Refineries with 68-Ton Capacity
Commodities.reason: Planned expansion of refining capacity increases processed output/liquidity for the gold market over time, a modest structural bearish signal for bullion.

Commodities.title: Kazakhstan Encouraged Local Banks to Finance Deal for Gold Miner
Commodities.reason: State-backed encouragement of local financing for a mine deal suggests easier funding for gold production/transactions, a modest bearish structural factor for gold supply/liquidity.

Commodities.title: Category 2 Hurricane Isaias nears landfall, leading to production shut-ins
Commodities.summary: As of 4:00 a.m. central time on October 9, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration expects Hurricane Isaias to make landfall on the Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday, creating the potential for significant disruptions to energy infrastructur
Commodities.reason: Storm-driven production shut-ins in the Gulf of Mexico present a clear near-term bullish disruption risk for oil and gas supply; relevance tied to potential immediate output impacts.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin ETFs are bleeding cash and the Fed is unlikely to help
Crypto.reason: Large ETF outflows reduce institutional/retail demand for BTC — negative for price and liquidity; Fed stance unlikely to offset flows, making this a meaningful bearish demand signal.

Crypto.title: Binance says customer withdrawals are fully restored, four weeks after the $6.3 billion hack
Crypto.reason: Restoration of withdrawals at the largest exchange restores on-chain liquidity and market functioning — confidence/reflow positive, though underlying hack remains a structural trust headwind.

Crypto.title: $7 billion of bitcoin options expire Friday, and the biggest bets look starkly different from October
Crypto.reason: Large options expiry can compress volatility and reshape positioning; article suggests a shift in bets versus prior month — modest short-term market impact and potential directional pressure.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin’s dormant supply rises, a behavior seen during previous bear-market bottoming phases
Crypto.reason: Rising dormant supply implies accumulation/long-term holder behavior consistent with bottoming phases — supportive for medium-term BTC demand narrative.

Crypto.title: Over 1,000 Bitcoin miners were tricked into working for a thief by a fake internet route
Crypto.reason: Large-scale hijacking of miner hashpower is a material security/operational incident for BTC infrastructure — negative for trust in mining operations and may pressure short-term supply dynamics.

Crypto.title: Standard Chartered's Zodia Custody suffers data breach, exposing client information
Crypto.reason: Custody-provider data breach undermines institutional trust and onboarding momentum — significant negative for institutional adoption and counterparty confidence.

Crypto.title: Hong Kong-based crypto trading firm Auros is winding down operations
Crypto.reason: Major trading firm winding down reduces market-making/liquidity capacity and signals stress among professional liquidity providers — negative for market depth and volatility.

Crypto.title: Spain gives anti-laundering unit power to freeze crypto accounts without a judge
Crypto.reason: Expanded AML enforcement powers increase regulatory risk and operational friction for users/exchanges in a major jurisdiction — net negative for activity and perceived privacy/rights.

Crypto.title: Bill to lock up U.S. government bitcoin for 20 years advances to full House
Crypto.reason: Legislative move to lock up government-held bitcoin would remove supply from market for an extended period — structurally supportive for BTC price if enacted or seriously considered.

Crypto.title: Ethereum's much-awaited Glamsterdam upgrade cleared for December test. Here's what to know
Crypto.reason: Successful testing/upgrade path for a major Ethereum protocol upgrade is positive for network utility, developer confidence, and ETH fundamentals — notable supportive tech signal.

Crypto.title: New York Attorney General wins $1.4 billion ruling against founders of crypto trading firm NovaTech
Crypto.reason: Large enforcement action highlights regulatory/legal tail risks and ongoing crackdowns on fraudulent trading firms — negative for market trust and speculative activity.

Crypto.title: Zcash developers want to phase out older privacy system as a precaution against future attacks
Crypto.reason: Proactive deprecation of an older privacy system reduces future attack surface and supports protocol safety; modestly positive for long-term project health though short-term friction for users.

Crypto.title: 'This time actually seems different': Crypto veterans brace for more pain as bitcoin tumbles
Crypto.reason: Negative market sentiment and veteran caution amplify risk-off positioning — contributes to potential further selling and reduced risk appetite in crypto markets.
